retrievalProfile.description: A centered rectangular landscape painting inset within a heavy-textured parchment border, featuring high-contrast italic serif typography and a horizontal rule.

recipe.visualDefinition: A composition defined by a central rectangular window containing a realist oil painting of a rural laborer, surrounded by a wide margin of fibrous, tan-colored handmade paper. The typography is integrated into the margins using a classic, high-contrast italic serif, anchored by a thin horizontal line.
coreVisualRelationships: Centralized rectangular image inset within a textured border
High-contrast black typography against a warm tan background
Visual weight balanced between top-aligned display text and bottom-right metadata
Contrast between the smooth sky in the painting and the rough texture of the paper
coreInvariants: Fibrous parchment texture with visible organic inclusions
Rectangular frame for the central artwork
Thin horizontal rule underlining the primary header

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The central painting occupies approximately 50% of the total area, centered horizontally and vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the painting acts as the primary focal point, supported by the bold header text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top header, move down to the central painting, and finish at the bottom-right subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial margins of textured paper provide breathing room and a sense of historical artifact.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow and sky blue (within the painting)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, earthy tones with high value contrast in the typography.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thicks and thins
characterSpecificRedesigns: Stacked 'AND THE' in smaller scale between primary name components
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and cases for consistency.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule underlining the top header

candidateDirections.reason: Classic transitional serif with high contrast and sharp terminals.
Provides the necessary historical weight and organic feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution texture of handmade tan parchment paper with visible fibers. Inset a rectangular oil painting in the center depicting a 19th-century rural scene with a harvester in a wheat field under a blue sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin black horizontal rule in the top margin. Above the rule, place large bold italic serif text in all caps. In the bottom right margin, place smaller title-case italic serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the parchment texture visible and organic?
Is the central painting rectangular and centered?
Is the top text underlined by a thin rule?
Is all text in a high-contrast italic serif?

mustRedesign: Do not use clean, vector-style borders
Ensure the painting style is painterly, not photographic
postGenerationChecks: Check that the 'AND THE' text is smaller and stacked if applicable
Ensure the rule line is perfectly horizontal and thin
Verify the painting has a distinct 'oil on canvas' texture
Confirm the parchment color is warm and aged
recipe.reuseFormula: Central Inset Painting + Fibrous Parchment Border + Underlined Italic Serif Header
